name: e8_costs
description: Cost realism at the 15-minute horizon on the v2 cache: returns VWAP-to-VWAP versus midquote-to-midquote (bid-ask bounce), execution latency 1, 5 and 30 seconds, and 2020 fees (Reg NMS take fee 0.003 USD/share and the SEC Section 31 rate 22.10e-6 on sales) on top of the spread at EFQ 0.7 and 1.0, for the IC-0.03 oracle and the real 15-minute reversal signal. Needs the v2 cache for Jul and Aug 2020 and results/signals/reversal_15m.npz. About 12 tasks of 8 configurations: roughly 10 minutes.
